items.claim: `invalid={false}` overrode the Field's error in the React Aria controls but not in UnitField
An empty `label` or `description` (`null`, `false`, `''`) counted as present, unlike an empty `error`
items.note: The same rule now also covers UnitField, the description under the boxed controls, and the boxed controls' own `label` (Input, TextArea, NumberField, ComboBox, Select, RadioGroup), so a control given an empty label inside a Field takes the field's label.

items.claim: The Field's error painted every frame inside it red, including controls the hook leaves valid
The Field's label was a `<span>` that neither pointed at the control's id nor reached the control on click
items.note: A `group` field keeps the `<span>`, since its members name themselves.

items.claim: The story's `NativeInput` overwrote the consumer's own id and names
items.note: It is story-only, so there is no reproducing test and no changeset.

items.claim: Empty label/description, as reported by B
items.note: duplicate of the A finding above.
